The notorious 'Time Traveler's Terror' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of future forensic techniques is the only hope for catching the killer. As she navigates the unfamiliar world of 1960s America, Rachel must use her skills to leave subtle clues that will aid her modern colleagues in tracking down the killer. With the help of a cryptic ally, Rachel must unravel the mystery before the killer strikes again, all while trying to find a way back to her own time. But as the body count rises, Rachel realizes that the killer's true intentions are far more sinister than she ever could have imagined. Can she solve the case before it's too late, or will the Time Traveler's Terror remain one step ahead? 1. The case begins with a gruesome discovery in 1962. 2.
